chunks: And when I have fashioned him and breathed into him of My spirit, bow before him in homage;

key_terms.سَوَّيْتُهُ: I fashioned him / I made him complete

ai.seo_question: What does it mean when God breathed His spirit into the created being?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse marks the transition from physical formation to spiritual elevation, where the 'breath of God' signifies the infusion of the divine soul (Ruh) into Adam, establishing his status as the perfect human (Insan al-Kamil). The command for angels to prostrate is viewed not merely as worship but as an act of reverence to the divine vicegerent, highlighting the hierarchy of creation and the unique ontological rank bestowed upon humanity.
